title: pump.fun new token row
description: One creation, read from the pump.fun program on Solana mainnet.

name.title: Name
name.description: Token name as written in the creation event.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Token symbol from the creation event.

uri.title: Metadata URI
uri.description: Where the token's off-chain metadata lives, as written by the creator.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Creator address from the creation event.

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Creation time from the on-chain event, ISO 8601 UTC.

ageSeconds.title: Age (seconds)
ageSeconds.description: Seconds between the creation and this row.

devBuyTokens.title: Creator buy, tokens
devBuyTokens.description: Tokens the creator bought in the creation transaction. null when it was not read.

devBuyPercent.title: Creator buy, % of supply
devBuyPercent.description: The same buy as a share of the total supply. null when it was not read.

virtualSolReserves.title: Virtual SOL reserves
virtualSolReserves.description: Virtual SOL on the bonding curve at creation, in SOL.

realSolReserves.title: Real SOL reserves
realSolReserves.description: Real SOL on the bonding curve at creation, in SOL.

curveProgressPercent.title: Curve progress
curveProgressPercent.description: Share of the 85 SOL the curve fills before the token migrates.

creatorTokensThisRun.title: Creator launches this run
creatorTokensThisRun.description: How many creations by the same creator this run had already seen before this one.

signature.title: Creation transaction
signature.description: Signature of the transaction that created the token.

source.title: Source
source.description: stream for the live logs subscription, poll for the HTTP fallback.
